text: Lavinia Corriero Yong-Ping, Community Development Officer, Community Safety and Wellbeing Unit, Social Development, Finance and Administration, will give a presentation on Specialized Program for Interdivisional Enhanced Response (SPIDER) Open Dialogue on Vulnerability events and provide an overview of a proposed event focused on issues affecting Indigenous People living in Toronto. The Open Dialogue on Vulnerability series is a monthly educational, networking, and outreach event hosted by the City of Toronto's SPIDER to Vulnerability partnership.
The Aboriginal Affairs Committee received the item for information.
